title: Number of Employees Who Met the Target
summary: Return the number of employees who worked at least target hours. hours[i] is the hours worked by employee i.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n == hours.length <= 50; hours values up to 10^5. The bounds for target were NOT captured from a source.
visualizationNotes: The target bound was not captured from a source, so requirementsVerified is false. Visualization uses the official 50-employee cap and a 0 to 100000 range for values and target.
